ALLOWED_EMAILS.description: Comma-separated email addresses permitted to sign in.

ACCOUNT_EMAIL.description: Default account email for layout and usage sync (must be in `ALLOWED_EMAILS`).

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Random secret (at least 32 characters) for signing sessions, for example from `openssl rand -hex 32`.

EMAIL_FROM.description: Verified sender address for sign-in codes and magic links.

AUTH_ORIGINS.description: Optional comma-separated HTTPS origins for custom domains. Leave blank on `workers.dev`.

COOKIE_DOMAIN.description: Optional shared cookie domain for custom subdomains. Leave blank on `workers.dev`.

RP_ID.description: Optional passkey relying-party domain. Leave blank to use the Worker hostname.
